native_display: ABI21 drawing module unchanged byte-for-byte; external controller keeps the active guardian heartbeat alive during the photo-page redraw (fixes progress retired mid-upload, consumer rc 77). No idle redraw timer.
changes: Fix photo-page progress failing mid-upload: the redraw wait now keeps the 3 s guardian heartbeat alive
Upload and display act as one service: a display failure finishes the current file, then stops the service (exit 91, no restart); stale display state is a failure, not a silent skip
SD root listings disturbed by native console messages are retried (75/76) instead of stopping the worker; genuine receipt conflicts still stop
Faster response: display start overlaps the pre-copy gate; recorder and card/open-handle checks run concurrently; photo-standby recorder sample authorises the SD receipt fast path

Lower idle load: quiet fallback scans step 30 s -> 60 s (photos) / 120 s (video only) after consecutive quiet results; settle re-checks end once the queue drains; unknown recorder layouts retry instead of polling for the whole session
FTP health retry capped at 2 min; per-upload phase timings and native query timings kept in a bounded RAM log
Installer: post-install health check bounded on the camera (no USB command timeout); held display lock reported as restart required; release payload contains no Wi-Fi diagnostics
